name: Trade Window Holdings Limited
summary: Trade Window Holdings Limited develops and commercialise technology solutions that provide international trade participants with a platform and tools in New Zealand, Australia, and internationally. The company offers Prodoc, a customizable enterprise document solution to leverage its customers IT investments with integration into either on-premises or cloud-based ERP systems; Freight, a solution for managing freight forwarding operations from order management to warehousing; Origin which is used for issue certificates of Origin in New Zealand for AANZFTA, CFTA, and RCEP; and SpeEDI Software, a cloud-based solution for cargo reporting and border clearance solution. It also provides Cube solution that enables businesses involved in global trade to securely share mission-critical data and collaborate with partners across the supply chain ecosystem; and Assure Plus, a software to collect and share information across supply chains easier. In addition, the company offers supply chain solutions for exporters, importers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, warehousing, auditor and certifiers, and marketers. It serves certifications and trust marks, coffee, diary, forestry, honey, horticulture, seed and grain, manufacturing, specialty, meat, wine, seafood, and other sectors. Trade Window Holdings Limited was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Takapuna, New Zealand.
